info.name: Ride-Hailing Dispatch (KVP)
info.description:
Acceptance-criteria scenarios for Coding Challenge #3. Start the stack first (`make up` in coding-challenge-3/kvp).

* **Run** the collection with the Runner (keep the order), or one folder at a time. From the terminal: `make postman`.
* **Folders:** one happy-path scenario, then one folder per acceptance criterion (AC-01 … AC-09). AC-10 (event-driven dispatch) is what every folder relies on: each result is reached asynchronously.
* **Self-contained:** each folder's first request picks a random spot on the map and creates its own drivers through the driver-service fixture API (`{{driverServiceUrl}}/internal/drivers/...`).
* **Asynchronous:** requests that check a result first wait in their pre-request script until it is reached.
* **Variables:** `baseUrl` (gateway, http://localhost:8080) and `driverServiceUrl` (http://localhost:8082).
* **API reference:** `api/openapi.yaml` (REST). gRPC v2 is not in this collection: see `api/proto` and `make grpc-offers`.

item.description: AC-01, AC-04, AC-05, AC-06, AC-10. Request a ride → the nearest driver gets an offer → accepts → ride completed → driver available again. Two drivers: A ~300 m and B ~1.5 km from the pickup.

const id = 'PM-' + v.slice(-1) + '-' + run;  // PM-A-… < PM-B-… (tie-break order)

}, (err, res) => { if (err || res.code !== 200) console.error('fixture driver failed', id, err || res.code); });
